subject: afl
title: AFL.------POL.CON.
description: Second diagram on page 127 (ALT(FT)II-21), paired with ACT × INFO-TRNS above. Where the first diagram crosses activism with information-transference, this one names what affinity-alignment meets when political-consciousness is the working partner: AFL (affinity alignment — the form's actual affinity orientation) crossed with POL-CON (political consciousness). AFL sits at right with the subject-arrow; SOC-RT-DY (social-reality dynamics) rises above and INFO-FM (information forum) sits at upper-right with IST-F (isolated focus) and PART (participation) further right. POL-P (political policies) sits centrally on the SOC-RT-DY line, with AGT (agreement) hanging below it, and ATTN (attraction) on the right margin. POL-CON sits at left as partner-axis. MOT-DY hangs at lower-left, branching from the main line. RTD-PRD (related procedure) sits centrally below, branching from RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits) at the bottom. Structural argument: when affinity-alignment is crossed with political-consciousness, SOC-RT-DY branches from the main line, with POL-P branching from the SOC-RT-DY line and AGT from the POL-P line. INFO-FM branches from the main line, ATTN from the INFO-FM line, IST-F from the ATTN line and PART from the IST-F line. MOT-DY branches downward from the main line, RT-INT-TR from the MOT-DY line, and RTD-PRD from the RT-INT-TR line.
